module_summary: Moore FSM that, after start input s, counts w=1 occurrences across each 3-cycle window and asserts z when exactly two occurred.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 8-state register tracking window position and w count; decoded to z in state C.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Moore output asserted when FSM is in state C (exactly two w ones).

anchors.name: s
anchors.why: Start input moving FSM from idle state A into checking state B.

anchors.name: w
anchors.why: Sampled bit whose ones are counted by the window transitions.

groups.name: Window counter FSM
groups.description: Next-state logic and state register counting w over 3-cycle windows; z decode.
